title: Charaideo district
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Charaideo district, in Upper Assam, was formed in 2015 from Sivasagar district. Its headquarters is Sonari town, and its name comes from Charaideo, the first capital of the Ahom kingdom.

Charaideo maidams

Charaideo has the maidams — earthen burial mounds of Ahom kings and nobles — inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2024. The district is otherwise agricultural, with tea gardens, rice and oil and coal areas near its borders.
